traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for Story 025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION are fully implemented and validated: - Dual-position detection and fallback for CatchClause annotations is implemented via gatherCatchClauseCommentText and wired through gatherBranchCommentText and getBranchAnnotationInfo. - Priority is given to annotations before the catch keyword; inside-catch comments are used as a fallback when before-catch annotations are absent. - Auto-fix for CatchClause places annotations inside the catch block body at the first statement’s line/indent, making them stable under Prettier. - Prettier integration tests confirm that code formatted with Prettier (both before-catch and inside-catch annotations, including empty catch blocks) passes the require-branch-annotation rule. - Rule-level tests and the full Jest suite passing provide strong evidence of no regressions for other branch types. - Rule documentation explicitly explains CatchClause annotation positions, Prettier compatibility, and mentions the supporting test suites.
Based on the concrete code, tests, and documentation, this story is fully satisfied.
